info.title: Report templates
info.description: Report templates: what a generated report counts and how it is laid out. A template names its data source (register, schema, filters), the date property a period narrows, and its sections. POST /api/reports/generate renders one over a period as PDF, ODS, XLSX, CSV or HTML, counting with the caller's rights. Materialised by the ImportReportTemplatesRegister repair step (ADR-037).

x-openregister.description: Report templates shipped by OpenRegister for the reporting chain (rapportage-bi-export). Apps add their own templates as seed objects of the report-templates schema.

report-templates.title: Report templates
report-templates.description: One object per report template. Apps ship their templates here as seed objects; administrators add their own.

report-templates.title: Report template
report-templates.summary: What a generated report counts, per section, over a period.
report-templates.description: A report template. dataSource names the register, schema and filters every section counts in unless the section names its own. dateField is the date property a period narrows (default _created). Each section is one aggregation in the period: total (one number), grouped (a metric per value of groupBy, with every key in rows present, 0 included) or series (a count per interval bucket of the date property). compareWithPreviousYear adds the same section one year earlier.

name.title: Name
name.description: The report's name, used in its title and file name.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: A stable identifier an app uses to find its own template.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the report is for; printed under its title.

app.title: App
app.description: The app that ships the template, empty for one an administrator made.

dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.description: The register, schema and filters every section counts in unless it names its own.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Property filters, as the aggregation API takes them.

dateField.title: Date property
dateField.description: The date property a period narrows; _created when empty.

key.title: Key
key.description: A stable identifier of the section.

title.title: Title
title.description: The section's heading in the report.

register.title: Register
register.description: This section's register, when not the template's.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: This section's schema, when not the template's.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Filters on top of the template's; a section naming its own register or schema does not take the template's filters.

dateField.title: Date property
dateField.description: This section's date property, when not the template's.

groupBy.title: Group by
groupBy.description: The property a grouped section counts per value of.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: count, sum, avg, min or max; count when empty.

field.title: Field
field.description: The numeric property sum, avg, min and max read.

interval.title: Interval
interval.description: The bucket of a series section.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: The keys a grouped section always shows, 0 included, in this order.

compareWithPreviousYear.title: Compare with the previous year
compareWithPreviousYear.description: Add the same section over the period one year earlier.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: The formats the template is meant to be generated in.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: The organisation name printed on the report.
